positions.name: MissingIdReproductionRequirements
positions.frame: What must a test that reproduces the missing-id (heading-without-id) production failure verify for Derive Id to be considered correct?
positions.why: src-1 sets the reproduction condition — the exact prod defect shape (## heading, no id field) — and src-2 states the outcome that condition must satisfy (no crash, valid slug produced). Read together, one directional line runs through both: they jointly define the correctness contract for how Derive Id must handle the missing-id case, not two independent facts. The affect/register reads support this pairing — src-1's calm, technical, present-tense description of the reproduced defect sets up src-2's activated, matter-of-fact modal 'must' clauses as the requirement that follows from it; conviction moves from bare claim (src-1) to settled decision (src-2), consistent with a single test-case description moving from setup to requirement rather than two unrelated assertions.
